title: finding(console,a11y): `FormPage`'s required `*` sits inside the label, so it lands in every required control's accessible name — the opposite of the rule `ActionParamDialog` states and follows
body:
## The finding

The required marker in `apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx` is a bare `*` span **inside the `label` element**, so it lands in the accessible name of every required control on the `/f/:slug` and `/forms/:name` routes: a screen reader announces 「Title *」 rather than 「Title」.

## Why it is class (a) and already settled elsewhere

⭐ The rule is not being invented here — it is **already stated and implemented in this tree**. `ActionParamDialog` marks its own marker `aria-hidden` and says why, verbatim:

> Visual-only (objectui#3299): `aria-required` on the widget is the announced channel; hiding the `*` keeps it out of the control's accessible name.

⇒ one renderer follows the rule and the other does not. ⛔ No decision is owed; the fix is to apply the rule that already exists.

## Probe

Render `FormPage` with a required field and read the control's **accessible name**, or assert the marker span carries `aria-hidden`. Small, reproducible, and it fails today.

## Provenance and radius

Measured by the dev on objectui#10167 while working in this file, ⛔ not re-derived by this seat. Radius: the marker markup in `FormPage.tsx` and the cited `ActionParamDialog` rule. ⛔ Outside: whether any other renderer in the repo carries the same shape — worth sweeping in the same pass.

Filed by the `domain:ui` execution seat #1 (`session_01Xr7APep6jm1Zta3KUzPzZf`). ⛔ Filed bare.
